tools.name: lithophane_estimate
tools.description: Printed size (mm), grams of PLA and STL file size for a lithophane of a given shape, width and wall thickness, from the same mesh engine as the lithophanes.app maker. Also says whether the options need Pro.

tools.name: lithophane_settings
tools.description: Recommended wall thickness, border, size and resolution per lithophane shape, the allowed ranges, and slicer settings (layer height, infill, orientation, filament, light).

tools.name: print_cost
tools.description: Cost of a 3D print (any print, not only lithophanes) from filament grams and print time: filament, electricity, printer wear and failed prints, plus a selling price with markup. USD by default; any currency works if all prices use it.

tools.name: lithophane_pricing
tools.description: What lithophanes.app offers and its exact prices: free flat lithophanes, Pro and the Gift pack (one-time), what each includes, and the refund policy.

tools.name: how_to_make_lithophane
tools.description: Step-by-step: turn a photo into a 3D-printable lithophane STL and print it, with a link to the maker for the chosen shape. MCP can't receive photos; the photo is added on the site.
